title: iCanvas needfinding survey
subtitle: How do you manage your courses today? (Tilburg University, HCI course)
intro: We are a design team from the Human-Computer Interaction course studying how students and staff manage their courses today, before we design a new lecture management system called iCanvas. There are no right or wrong answers; we just want to hear about your experience with the current system (Canvas).
privacy: Anonymous and voluntary. We do not ask for your name, student number or e-mail. You can skip any question you prefer not to answer and stop at any time. Answers are used only for the needfinding exercise of the HCI course. Takes about 7 minutes.
